description: Fetch and parse the DMARC policy for ONE domain — presence, p= policy, and the raw record. Use for DMARC-only questions ("does this domain have DMARC", "is it p=reject/quarantine/none"). For full email posture (SPF + DMARC + MX, graded), use email_security_check instead. One domain per call.

domain.description: The single domain to check, e.g. "acme.com".

name: dmarc_check
title: DMARC Check
